description: Grow the Mellos map: set the title and diagram kind, add layer bands, lanes and groups (labeled subsystems within ONE band — declare them when a single band grows crowded, roughly five or more nodes in that band; a group must be a strict subset of its band, and a map spread thin across many bands needs none), add nodes, add dependency edges. Declare the missing design after reading existing pages with mmap_read; reuse verified nodes. Edges must point strictly downward (a node may only use nodes on lower layers); the batch is all-or-nothing. Title and kind can also be changed with mmap_update; this legacy form remains supported. Revising what already exists (moving, renaming, relabeling, clearing) is mmap_update.

next.description: Next actions for resuming this effort

from.description: the node that USES the other (must live on a higher layer)

to.description: the node being used (must live on a strictly lower layer)

expectedRevision.description: Revision from mmap_read; absent requires a new page. A stale revision returns CONFLICT.

id.description: stable kebab-case identifier of the group

label.description: subsystem name shown at the far zoom

layer.description: band this group clusters; members must live on the same band

kind.description: diagram kind. dev (default) = the live progress ledger with status skins. The rest are documentation diagrams rendered neutrally: architecture (layered components; also fits call graphs and module dependencies), dataflow (source→transform→sink, stages as layers), behavior-tree (root on top, leaves at the bottom; also fits mind maps and WBS), sequence (classic call/return: rank = time step with rank 0 = EARLIEST, drawn top-down; declare lanes as participants and make every call AND every return its own event node in the acting participant's lane, edges labeled with the message). State machines are unsupported: cycles cannot enter a Mellos map.

lanes.description: vertical columns crossing all bands; declaration order = left-to-right

id.description: stable kebab-case identifier of the lane

label.description: column name, e.g. a sequence participant

id.description: stable kebab-case identifier of the band

rank.description: an integer in 0..99, 0 = bottom / most primitive; must be unique among the map's bands

detail.description: design notes shown in the pane detail panel: responsibility, contract, key decisions

evidence.description: how an already-verified node was verified; for regressed: what broke. Declaring a node straight to done needs it as much as updating one does.

group.description: same-band group this node belongs to

id.description: stable kebab-case identifier of the node

kind.description: node kind rendered as a glyph prefix. Known: selector | sequence | parallel | decorator | condition | action (behavior trees); source | transform | sink (dataflow); service | db | queue | ui (architecture). Unknown kinds are kept and shown in the detail panel.

layer.description: id of the band this node lives in

sources.description: Optional source files and verified SHA256 baselines. mmap_read changes checks them without rescanning the repository.

status.description: defaults to planned. planned = ghost on the map; in-progress = spinner; done = verified; regressed = was done, now broken

submap.description: page slug of this node's child map — the pane badges the node ⊞ and double-click dives in. Declare the child page separately. Create a sub-map only when the node's internals genuinely deserve their own picture; most nodes need none.

page.description: page (parallel map) this call targets; omit for the default page. A new conversation is not a new effort. Read existing pages with mmap_read first; reuse the same page for continued work. Create a new page only for a distinct effort.

anyOf.description: map title, e.g. the feature being built; null removes it

title.description: map title, e.g. the feature being built; null removes it

name: mmap_declare
title: Declare map structure
